metadata.name: Redhair Quality — Complete Setup
metadata.description: Redhair supplied defaults with independently selectable sections. Apply full setup, SEL/regex only, or selected sections. Unselected fields are omitted to preserve existing customizations. Never imports proxy settings, service credentials or variants. Default profiles: synced 2160p Remux and Anime Remux 1080p.
metadata.author: Local adaptation

inputs.name: What to apply
inputs.description: Full setup applies Redhair’s defaults. SEL/regex only preserves everything else. Choose sections enables individual switches.

inputs.name: Sections to apply
inputs.description: Enabled sections replace their current settings. Disabled sections stay exactly as they are.

subOptions.name: SEL and regex
subOptions.description: All stream expressions, regex patterns, synced URLs and score overrides. Replaces the selected section, including custom SEL edits.

subOptions.name: Basic filters
subOptions.description: Resolution, quality, language, audio/video, keyword, cached-stream and other basic filters.

subOptions.name: Sorting
subOptions.description: All cached, uncached, movie, series and anime sort orders.

subOptions.name: Result, size and bitrate limits
subOptions.description: Result counts, size ranges and bitrate settings.

subOptions.name: Add-ons, catalogs and fetching
subOptions.description: Add-on list, category colors, catalogs, groups and dynamic fetching. Includes connection placeholders for your own endpoints.

subOptions.name: Formatter and posters
subOptions.description: Stream display formatter and poster service selection.

subOptions.name: Metadata matching and SeaDex
subOptions.description: Year/title/episode matching, language inference and SeaDex enablement.

subOptions.name: Playback, downloads and failover
subOptions.description: Autoplay, preloading, cache-and-play, owned checks, failover and service wrapping.

subOptions.name: Statistics and errors
subOptions.description: Statistics display and hidden error resources.

inputs.name: Your existing connections are preserved
inputs.description: Proxy settings, service credentials and variants are never imported. Configure services separately for a new setup. Importing add-ons replaces the add-on list and may prompt for connection details. SEL/regex includes synced 2160p Remux + Anime Remux 1080p and Redhair’s score overrides.

__value.expression: /*Bitrate Filter*/((queryType == 'anime.series') or (queryType == 'anime.movie')or ('Animation' in genres)) ? [] : merge(bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 1, '25Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'Bluray'), 1, '13.6Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'WEB-DL', 'WEBRip'), 1, '4.6Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '2160p'), 'HDTV'), 1, '11.33Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 1, '13.6Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'Bluray'), 1, '6.77Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'WEB-DL', 'WEBRip'), 1, '1.67Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '1080p'), 'HDTV'), 1, '4.51Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '720p'), 'Bluray'), 1, '3.43Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '720p'), 'WEB-DL', 'WEBRip'), 1, '1.67Mbps'), bitrate(quality(resolution(streams, '720p'), 'HDTV'), 1, '2.28Mbps'))
/*ongoing Season Pack*/((queryType=='series' or queryType=='anime.series') and ongoingSeason and (daysSinceLastAired <-1 or daysUntilNextEpisode>=0))?seasonPack(streams,'onlySeasons'):[]

__value.condition: (queryType=='anime.series')?((count(seadex(cached(totalStreams),'best'))>=1 and count(totalStreams)>=5) or (totalTimeTaken>=5000 and (count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Anime BD T1','Anime Web T1'))>=4 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'1080p'))>=12)) or totalTimeTaken>=7000) : (queryType=='anime.movie' or (queryType == 'anime.series' or queryType == 'anime.movie'))?((count(seadex(cached(totalStreams),'best'))>=1 and count(totalStreams)>=5) or (totalTimeTaken>=5000 and (count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Anime BD T1'))>=3 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'2160p'))>=6)) or totalTimeTaken>=7000) : (queryType=='movie')?((count(totalStreams)>=5 and ('N-Central' in queriedAddons or 'Althub' in queriedAddons or 'U-Crawler' in queriedAddons) and (count(type(totalStreams,'usenet','debrid'))>=1 or count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Remux T1','Bluray T1'))>=2 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'2160p'))>=8)) or (count(totalStreams)>=20 and ('Debridio' in queriedAddons or 'Torz' in queriedAddons or 'Torrentio' in queriedAddons) and count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Remux T1','Bluray T1'))>=5) or totalTimeTaken>=7000) : ((count(totalStreams)>=5 and ('N-Central' in queriedAddons or 'Althub' in queriedAddons or 'U-Crawler' in queriedAddons) and (count(type(totalStreams,'usenet','debrid'))>=1 or count(regexMatched(cached(totalStreams),'Web T1','Remux T1'))>=2 or count(resolution(cached(totalStreams),'2160p','1080p'))>=15)) or totalTimeTaken>=7000)
